name: Elisa
source:
An arrogant, intelligent vampire.

"It's foolish to be trapped in the same regret forever. For both you and I..."

An intelligent woman who cooperates with Gran to perform the princess's training ritual.

A "Vampire" who possesses the power of a curse that lived for a hundred years by drinking on people's blood. Her captivating body exudes demonic allure, and she is confident with it.

She is a cool but arrogant character. She enjoys inciting others with her sarcasm. She possesses the power of "mental manipulation", allowing her to charm others and control their bodies.

She seems to have some other objective behind the scenes for cooperating with the ritual...

[Translated from [url=https://www.escude.co.jp/product/testament/chara02.html]official website[/url]]
